sources.snippet: Zephyr-7b-beta Zephyr is a series of language models that are trained to act as helpful assistants. Zephyr-7B-β is the second model in the series, and is a fine-tuned version of mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 that was trained on on a mix of publicly available, synthetic datasets using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

sources.snippet: Zephyr-7B-Beta is a high-performance open-source instruction-tuned model from Hugging Face, based on the Mistral architecture. Using direct preference optimization, it achieves excellent dialogue capabilities and logical reasoning while remaining lightweight, making it a quality choice for edge deployment and general text generation.

sources.snippet: zephyr-7b-beta Zephyr-7B-β is a 7-billion-parameter open-source chat model fine-tuned from Mistral-7B using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). It ranks highly on standard benchmarks (MT-Bench, AlpacaEval) for 7B-class models and is designed for conversational AI. The model is MIT-licensed, non-gated, and suitable for self-hosted deployment.
